title: Documentary Service Fee and Electronic Filing Fee on Vehicle Purchase Agreements
content:
**The fee.** On the **Vehicle Purchase Agreements** the documentary service fee is posted once per deal on the contract date. Its amount is the lesser of two figures, rounded to the cent (half up):
- the selling store's documentary service fee, looked up by the store code of the deal's store; and
- the deal type's documentary fee ceiling multiplied by the deal's cash price.

Where the deal type's documentary fee is waived, no documentary fee is posted. The flat electronic filing service fee of the deal type is posted once per deal on the contract date.

**No second posting.** A documentary fee already posted on a deal is not posted again. The deal's own posted charges are the evidence.

**Correction of an over-posted fee.** A documentary fee found posted above the amount computed here is corrected by one reversal of the excess, pointing at the original charge. A fee posted at or below the computed amount is left as posted.

## Worked figures (hypothetical deals, with a 10 percent ceiling and a store fee of 233.00)

| Cash price | Ceiling amount | Store fee | Documentary fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1990.00 | 199.00 | 233.00 | 199.00 (the ceiling is lower) |
| 6400.00 | 640.00 | 233.00 | 233.00 (the store fee is lower) |

| Fee found posted | Fee computed | Correction |
|---|---|---|
| 260.00 | 199.00 | one reversal of 61.00 pointing at the posted charge |
| 199.00 | 199.00 | none; left as posted |
| 150.00 | 199.00 | none; left as posted |
